text: bipl5 builds interactive PCA CVA biplots using plotly via htmlwidgets. central user-facing workflow : wrap_bipl5() S3 generic dispatches wrap_bipl5.PCA() wrap_bipl5.CVA() based class biplotEZ object. returns bipl5_biplot object — rich, self-contained R structure can printed, inspected, subsetted, extended, plotted. Key features: - Biplot display (LHS) observation points multiple visual layers: - data points (hovertext showing actual predicted values) - optional polygons (alpha bags / concentration ellipses) - class means (CVA biplots always; PCA requested) - linear axes (calibrated axes) - translated density axes (TDA) (“ExpAx” axes + densities) - vector representation (PCA ; applicable CVA) - unit circle / outer circle layers (PCA ) - Fit panel (RHS) shown/hidden via “Measures Fit” button (PCA ): - cumulative predictivity - cumulative adequacy - scree plot - proportion variance explained - summary table (PC-pair-dependent) - PC/CV toggle dropdown switch dimension pairs: - PCA: PC 1 & 2, PC 1 & 3, PC 2 & 3 (always 3 pairs) - CVA: 3 CV pairs, determined min(g-1, p) g = number groups - Event-driven interactions JS: - legend clicks toggle axes / layers / densities - clicking observation draws “prediction lines” axes - translated axes toggle centered axes (“Ax”) translated axes (“ExpAx”) - optional slider-driven parallel axis translation (ExpAx)

title: PCA Biplots
text: section preserves current long-form PCA documentation narrative form. Let \(\mathbf{X} \\mathbb{R}^{n \times p}\) denote processed data matrix stored input object centring optional scaling. PCA performed processed matrix, singular value decomposition \[ \mathbf{X} = \mathbf{U}\mathbf{D}\mathbf{V}^{\top}, \] \(\mathbf{U}^{\top}\mathbf{U} = \mathbf{}\), \(\mathbf{V}^{\top}\mathbf{V} = \mathbf{}\), \(\mathbf{D} = \operatorname{diag}(d_1, \ldots, d_q)\) \(q = \operatorname{rank}(\mathbf{X})\) \(d_1 \ge \cdots \ge d_q \ge 0\). principal component score vectors \[ \mathbf{z}_t = d_t \mathbf{u}_t = \mathbf{X}\mathbf{v}_t, \qquad t = 1, \ldots, q. \] Suppose displayed pair \((, b)\) \(< b\). Let \(\mathbf{J}_{ab}\) diagonal selector matrix ones positions \(\) \(b\). two-dimensional fitted matrix \[ \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} = \mathbf{U}\mathbf{D}\mathbf{J}_{ab}\mathbf{V}^{\top} = \mathbf{X}\mathbf{V}\mathbf{J}_{ab}\mathbf{V}^{\top}. \] Equivalently, \(\mathbf{U}_{ab}\), \(\mathbf{D}_{ab}\), \(\mathbf{V}_{ab}\) containing selected components, \[ \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} = \mathbf{U}_{ab}\mathbf{D}_{ab}\mathbf{V}_{ab}^{\top} = d_a \mathbf{u}_a \mathbf{v}_a^{\top} + d_b \mathbf{u}_b \mathbf{v}_b^{\top}. \] ordinary PCA biplot displayed sample coordinates \[ \mathbf{Z}_{ab} = \mathbf{U}_{ab}\mathbf{D}_{ab}, \qquad \mathbf{H}_{ab} = \mathbf{V}_{ab}, \] \[ \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} = \mathbf{Z}_{ab}\mathbf{H}_{ab}^{\top}. \] \(\mathbf{h}_{(j)}\) displayed direction variable \(j\), fitted value observation \(\) variable \(j\) \[ \widehat{x}_{ij} = \mathbf{z}_i^{\top}\mathbf{h}_{(j)}, \] calibrated axis point corresponding marker value \(\mu\) \[ \mathbf{p}_{\mu j} = \frac{\mu}{\mathbf{h}_{(j)}^{\top}\mathbf{h}_{(j)}}\mathbf{h}_{(j)}. \] correlation biplot factorization can instead written \[ \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} = \mathbf{U}_{ab}(\mathbf{V}_{ab}\mathbf{D}_{ab})^{\top}, \] displayed sample coordinates \(\mathbf{U}_{ab}\) displayed variable directions rows \(\mathbf{V}_{ab}\mathbf{D}_{ab}\). setting variable directions tuned variable-correlation structure rather raw score geometry. Two orthogonality relations central: \[ \mathbf{X}\mathbf{X}^{\top} = \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab}\widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab}^{\top} + \mathbf{E}_{ab}\mathbf{E}_{ab}^{\top}, \] \[ \mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{X} = \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab}^{\top}\widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} + \mathbf{E}_{ab}^{\top}\mathbf{E}_{ab}, \] \(\mathbf{E}_{ab} = \mathbf{X} - \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab}\). first justifies sample-side fit measures (Type orthogonality), second justifies variable-side fit measures (Type B orthogonality). sample \(\), sample predictivity \[ \psi_i = \frac{\|\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{\cdot}\|^2}      {\|\mathbf{x}_{\cdot}\|^2} = 1 - \frac{\|\mathbf{x}_{\cdot} - \widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{\cdot}\|^2}      {\|\mathbf{x}_{\cdot}\|^2}. \] variable \(j\), axis predictivity \[ \phi_j = \frac{\|\widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{(j)}\|^2}      {\|\mathbf{x}_{(j)}\|^2} = 1 - \frac{\|\mathbf{x}_{(j)} - \widehat{\mathbf{x}}_{(j)}\|^2}      {\|\mathbf{x}_{(j)}\|^2}. \] overall quality displayed PCA plane \[ R^2_{\mathrm{disp},ab} = \frac{\|\widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab}\|_F^2}{\|\mathbf{X}\|_F^2} = \frac{d_a^2 + d_b^2}{\sum_{t = 1}^q d_t^2}. \] orthogonality, quantity can read weighted average either sample predictivities axis predictivities. variable side, \[ R^2_{\mathrm{disp},ab} = \sum_{j = 1}^p w_j \phi_j, \qquad w_j = \frac{\|\mathbf{x}_{(j)}\|^2}{\|\mathbf{X}\|_F^2}. \] processed variables equal sums squares, overall quality simply average axis predictivity. one reason standardized PCA often easy interpret. PCA also gives clean per-component decomposition. Since \[ \widehat{\mathbf{X}}_{ab} = d_a \mathbf{u}_a \mathbf{v}_a^{\top} + d_b \mathbf{u}_b \mathbf{v}_b^{\top}, \] two displayed rank-1 pieces orthogonal, therefore \[ R^2_{\mathrm{disp},ab} = R_a^2 + R_b^2, \qquad R_a^2 = \frac{d_a^2}{\|\mathbf{X}\|_F^2}, \qquad R_b^2 = \frac{d_b^2}{\|\mathbf{X}\|_F^2}. \] Likewise, \[ \phi_j = \phi_{ja} + \phi_{jb}, \qquad \psi_i = \psi_{ia} + \psi_{ib}, \] axis-side sample-side quality can broken two displayed components. package documentation also distinguishes sum--squares measures direct-reading diagnostics Alves (2012). \(\mathbf{g}_{(j)}\) displayed direction variable \(j\), read-value axis sample \(\) \[ \widehat{x}_{ij} = \mathbf{z}_i^{\top}\mathbf{g}_{(j)}. \] direct-reading error \[ \delta_{ij} = \frac{|x_{ij} - \widehat{x}_{ij}|}{s_j}, \] \(s_j\) standard deviation used preprocessing, mean axis-level direct-reading error \[ \bar{\delta}_j = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{= 1}^n \delta_{ij}. \] quantities answer different question predictivity. Predictivity asks much sum squares reproduced displayed plane. Alves diagnostics ask accurately values can read directly plotted calibrated axes. per-observation direct-reading errors \(\delta_{ij}\) can attached biplot score_axes(). Inserting step construction pipeline adds extra Error column, expressed percentage (\(100\,\delta_{ij}\)), hover table appears data point hovered , alongside actual predicted values. calculation performed every displayed dimension pair (mdsDisplay) object, applies equally PCA, PCO CVA biplots. diagnostic opt-, computed score_axes() called.
